notes.title: UPDATE 5/30/2023 - Unreal Engine 5 Conversion.
notes.notes:
UPDATE 5/30/2023

Engine
Converted Game Engine to Unreal Engine 5

Maps
Added - Golf Park - High Quality
Converted Golf Park to Nanite
Converted Alien Planet to Nanite
Converted Castle to Nanite
Converted Ghost Town to Nanite
Converted Golf Park Night to Nanite
Converted Volcanic to Nanite
Converted Dark Fantasy to Nanite
Converted main menu to Nanite
Converted Arcade Lobby to Nanite

Converted all maps to Nanite and optimized lighting.

Player UI 
Removed Spinning clock for time left for hole.
Adjusted colors of Server name and password to be easier seen when hosting a game.

Physics
Adjusted Physics so the ball will roll a little more before stopping.

Bug Fixes
Ghost Town, Hole 2 had clipping on the back side of the hole preventing players from coming back up.

notes.title: Update 0.40.2
notes.notes:
Update 0.40.2

Game

- Added function to adjust hole time allowed while playing each hole.

- Timer no longer missing the 0 in some instances, now displays proper time.

- On initial start up, game will run a benchmark test and auto adjust graphics to help optimize the 
   game on start up.

Lobby

- Resetting will now place you back in lobby

Racer

- Space war portal removed and added different obstacles in its place

notes.title: Update 0.40.0
notes.notes:
Update 0.40.0

Lobby

- Balls will no longer get stuck on top of Rolling Ball Machines.

- Outside area removed for Lobby Optimization.

Maps

Culling is the term used for objects being removed and re-added to scenes depending on camera distance from the the objects being culled. Greatly improves performance by removing things you don't see.

Castle 

- Culling optimization added.


Volcanic

- Culling optimization added.


Golf Park

- Culling Optimization added.

Dark Fantasy 

-Culling Optimization added.

notes.title: Update 0.37.0 Physics and Optimization Update
notes.notes:
Update 0.37.0

Please keep note that the only optimization update at this time is related to Golf Park Night, 
Optimization of all maps to follow soon.

Game

- Reset timer reduced to 3 seconds from 5 seconds.


- Ball now comes to a complete stop when hit indicator is active and will not keep inching forward


- Friction adjusted from .7 to .8 so that the ball slows and comes to a stop a little faster on putt areas.


Lobby 

- Adjusted UI Graphics in Lobby Menu

Maps

Golf Park

- Balls will no longer get stuck in corner triangles.

- Hole 15 ramp adjustment.

Golf Park Night

- Balls will no longer get stuck in corner triangles.

- Hole 15 ramp adjustment

- Added Culling of objects to increase performance.

- Added Culling of Foliage to increase performance.

Alien Planet

- Hole 4 redesigned.

notes.title: Update Patch notes 0.32.5
notes.notes:
Update 0.32.5

Game

- Search filter in find sessions menu fixed. It is no longer case sensitive and doesn't search for exact matches.
- Mouse sensitivity settings included
- Jumping after completing hole fixed.
- Widget to show player's progress in XP, their coins and gems added

Lobby

- Lobby Arcade Building added "currently non functional"

Maps

Alien Planet

- Added neon arrow signs to be used for holes where the path to take may not be fully understood by players.
- Adjusted position of hole for hole 10 to be centered to starting position. Additionally, adjusted terrain preventing completion of hole 10.
- Adjusted piston strength  to return better odds of landing player in the intended location
- Added Camera Collision to landscape of Alien Forest
